name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task commands 'reach the exit', which is an unconditional requirement. However, the clauses only provide a Response(at_exit, holding_box), which does not require the agent to actually reach the exit (an Existence(at_exit) is missing). Furthermore, 'Reach the exit' should be an Existence(at_exit) and 'you must be carrying the box' should be a Response(at_exit, holding_box). Because Existence(at_exit) is missing, the machine has no final state, which is incorrect for a task with an unconditional goal. Add a hard Existence(at_exit) to the clauses.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) captures the goal to reach the exit; Response(at_exit, holding_box) ensures the box is held when the exit is reached; and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) correctly handles the requirement to pick up the box on the very next move after a fall.
